rule: 3.2.1 - Volunteers for denied boarding
situation: When confirmed passengers exceed available seats, the airline must first seek volunteers to give up their seats.
compensation: Benefits or facilities offered at the airline's discretion to volunteers.
facilities: Benefits offered in exchange for voluntarily surrendering the reservation.

rule: 3.2.2 - Denied boarding with alternate flight within one hour
situation: A passenger is involuntarily denied boarding despite having a confirmed booking.
compensation: No compensation when the alternate flight is scheduled to depart within one hour of the original departure.
facilities: Alternate flight arrangement.

rule: 3.2.2(a) - Denied boarding with alternate flight within 24 hours
situation: A passenger is involuntarily denied boarding and the alternate flight departs within 24 hours.
compensation: 200% of booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, subject to a maximum of INR 10,000.
facilities: Alternate flight.

rule: 3.2.2(b) - Denied boarding with alternate flight after 24 hours
situation: A passenger is involuntarily denied boarding and the alternate flight departs more than 24 hours later.
compensation: 400% of booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, subject to a maximum of INR 20,000.
facilities: Alternate flight.

rule: 3.2.2(c) - Passenger declines alternate flight
situation: A passenger is involuntarily denied boarding and does not opt for the alternate flight.
compensation: Full ticket refund plus 400% of booked one-way basic fare and airline fuel charge, subject to a maximum of INR 20,000.
facilities: Full ticket refund.

rule: 3.2.3 - Denied boarding on connecting flights
situation: A passenger on connecting flights is delayed at the first departure station due to denied boarding and reaches the final destination at least three hours late.
flight_duration: Final arrival at least three hours later
compensation: Compensation according to clause 3.2.2, payable by the airline operating the first flight.
facilities: Compensation under denied boarding provisions.

rule: 3.3.1 - Cancellation notice at least two weeks
situation: The airline cancels a flight and informs the passenger at least two weeks before departure.
compensation: Alternate flight or refund as acceptable to the passenger.
facilities: Alternate flight or ticket refund.

rule: 3.3.1 - Cancellation notice less than two weeks and up to 24 hours
situation: The airline informs the passenger of cancellation less than two weeks but up to 24 hours before departure.
notice_period: Less than 14 days and at least 24 hours
compensation: Alternate flight or ticket refund as acceptable to the passenger.
facilities: Alternate flight or ticket refund.

rule: 3.3.2(a) - Cancellation compensation for flights up to one hour
situation: The passenger was not informed according to the cancellation notice requirements.
flight_duration: Block time up to and including one hour
compensation: INR 5,000 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less, in addition to full refund.
facilities: Alternate flight or full refund; airport facilities where applicable.

rule: 3.3.2(b) - Cancellation compensation for flights over one and up to two hours
situation: The passenger was not informed according to the cancellation notice requirements.
flight_duration: More than one hour and up to two hours
compensation: INR 7,500 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less, in addition to full refund.
facilities: Alternate flight or full refund; airport facilities where applicable.

rule: 3.3.2(c) - Cancellation compensation for flights over two hours
situation: The passenger was not informed according to the cancellation notice requirements.
compensation: INR 10,000 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less, in addition to full refund.
facilities: Alternate flight or full refund; airport facilities where applicable.

rule: 3.3.3 - Inadequate passenger contact information
situation: The passenger did not provide adequate email or phone contact information at booking.
compensation: No financial compensation; refund or reasonable alternate travel arrangements must be offered.
facilities: Reasonable waiting facilities when travelling on an alternate flight.

rule: 3.3.4 - Cancellation due to extraordinary circumstances
situation: The flight cancellation is caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond the airline's control, despite reasonable measures.
compensation: No financial compensation under this clause.
facilities: Refer to applicable refund and alternate travel provisions.

rule: 3.4.1(a) - Delay facilities for flights up to 2.5 hours
situation: A checked-in passenger faces an expected delay of two hours or more.
compensation: No fixed financial compensation specified in this clause.
facilities: Free meals and refreshments in relation to waiting time.

rule: 3.4.1(b) - Delay facilities for flights over 2.5 and up to five hours
situation: A checked-in passenger faces an expected delay of three hours or more.
flight_duration: More than 2.5 hours and up to five hours
compensation: No fixed financial compensation specified in this clause.
facilities: Free meals and refreshments in relation to waiting time.

rule: 3.4.1(c) - Delay facilities for other flight durations
situation: A checked-in passenger faces an expected delay of four hours or more.
flight_duration: Flights not covered by clauses 3.4.1(a) and 3.4.1(b)
compensation: No fixed financial compensation specified in this clause.
facilities: Free meals and refreshments in relation to waiting time.

rule: 3.4.2 - Domestic flight delay exceeding six hours
situation: A domestic flight is expected to be delayed more than six hours.
compensation: No fixed financial compensation specified in this clause.
facilities: Alternate flight within six hours or full ticket refund.

rule: 3.4.3 - Long delay and overnight delay facilities
situation: Total delay exceeds 24 hours, or exceeds six hours for flights scheduled between 20:00 and 03:00.
flight_duration: Delay over 24 hours, or over six hours for specified night departures
compensation: No fixed financial compensation specified in this clause.
facilities: Hotel accommodation when necessary, including transfers.

rule: 3.5.1 - Involuntary downgrading on domestic flights
situation: A passenger is involuntarily carried in a lower class than the class purchased.
compensation: Reimbursement of 75% of the ticket cost, including taxes.
facilities: Reimbursement for the downgrade.

rule: 3.8.1 - Free passenger facilities
situation: Passengers affected by denied boarding, cancellations or delays qualify for facilities under the relevant provisions.
compensation: No separate financial compensation specified in this clause.
facilities: Free meals and refreshments in relation to waiting time; hotel accommodation when necessary, including transfers.
